# Templates

Reusable markdown templates and formats for common project artifacts.

## Decision & tracking

- \decision-record.md\ — template for recording durable project decisions
- \supervisor-decision-change-log.md\ — template for tracking supervisor-decision changes and supersessions

## Meeting & documentation

- \weekly-supervisor-pre-read.md\ — template for preparing weekly supervisor pre-reads with commitment, evidence, blockers, decisions
- \meeting-note.md\ — template for recording meeting notes with participants, key decisions, action items

## Research & experiments

- \eading-note.md\ — template for literature review and reading annotations with source, key findings, relevance
- \xperiment-card.md\ — template for documenting experiment design, protocol, expected results, and interpretation

## Usage

1. Copy the relevant template to your working location
2. Fill in the sections with concrete details
3. Link back to the source template for consistency
